delivery: One source-only submissions/<folder> module with tests and documented behavior; unchanged ABI/host; no GUI/devices.
review: Local host/Windows integration and review required even after kit tests pass.
name: Slew
behavior: Linear slew: seconds are duration for one unit of change, not exponential time constant. Output moves toward input by at most 1/(sampleRate*time) per sample, never overshoots.
Zero selected time snaps for that direction. Unpatched target0; negative and >1 controls are valid, not clipped. Reset output0; retain Rise/Fall targets.
Read live target/time per sample; no block-quantized decisions; time parameters are immediate rate limits, not generic amplitude ramps.
Exponential Lag mode is explicitly deferred rather than silently changing the linear time semantics.
acceptance: Positive/negative steps, separate rise/fall, exact zero-time snap, final target convergence.
One-unit step at .1s reaches target at expected sample count; multi-unit duration scales with distance.
Changing target midway, partition equality and guards.
